name: Abimelech son of Gideon
charge: Murder of seventy brothers on one stone; usurping a crown
summary: Gideon's son by a Shechemite concubine hired vain and light persons with silver from the house of Baal-berith, killed his seventy brothers on one stone, and had himself made king at Shechem. Only Jotham escaped, and his parable from Mount Gerizim pronounced the sentence.
offense: Fratricide financed by an idol's treasury, in pursuit of a kingship God had not given and Gideon had refused. Jotham: if ye have dealt truly, rejoice in Abimelech; if not, let fire come out from Abimelech and devour the men of Shechem, and fire from Shechem devour Abimelech.
judgment: God sent an evil spirit between Abimelech and Shechem; he destroyed the city and sowed it with salt, and at Thebez a woman dropped a millstone on his head. He had his armor-bearer finish him so it would not be said a woman slew him. Thus God rendered the wickedness of Abimelech.
